newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Foods completes sale of two subsidiaries.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Foods completes sale of two subsidiaries.

text.p: Specialty Foods Corp said it completed the sale of its B & G Foods and Burns & Ricker subsidiaries to B Companies Acquisition Corp, a new corporation organized by Bruckmann, Rosser, Sherrill & Co Inc.
The price for the Roseland, N.J.-based companies was not disclosed.
Specialty Foods Corp, a subsidiary of Specialty Foods Acquisition Corp, was formed in 1993 through the acquisition of eight separate food companies with annual revenues of about $2 billion.
